notes_for_editor: The record coordinates (30.92639, -90.72917) match the Wikipedia list exactly, and the list status is 'Still standing/active use', so the record's standing status is confirmed. The list's location column reads Greensburg (the parish seat) rather than Liverpool, so the place name and the tower name differ; the story says so. No build date, builder, design, staffing or access information was found. Searches returned nothing specific to this tower. Guessed Forest Lookouts, Fire Lookout and NHLR URLs returned 404. The Forest Lookouts index and the FFLOS Louisiana page were checked, but the FFLOS table was cut off in the read, so its absence of this tower is unconfirmed. Budget used: 2 websearch.py calls and 6 page reads (including the 404s).
